title: EdgeMesh: A Distributed Edge Computing Framework for IoT Applications
research_problem: Centralized edge orchestrators suffer from single points of failure and bandwidth bottlenecks under dense IoT micro-clouds.
approach: Decentralized mesh-based coordination where edge devices collaborate peer-to-peer to schedule microservices dynamically.
key_contribution: Formulated distributed work-stealing and task offloading protocols reducing end-to-end task delay by 34% without central server.
edge_relevance: Direct blueprint for decentralized edge-cloud collaboration and peer-to-peer computation offloading.

title: Collaborative Edge AI Inference with Dynamic Early-Exit Networks
research_problem: Running heavy deep neural networks on energy-constrained IoT edge devices causes extreme latency and battery exhaustion.
approach: Adaptive early-exit backbone with progressive multi-device feature sharing across edge clusters.
key_contribution: Achieved 92% Top-1 accuracy while cutting average inference latency by 52% across heterogeneous edge nodes.
edge_relevance: Direct alignment with Edge AI, model compression, and split computing research questions.

title: Cloud-Edge Collaborative Intelligence: Architectures, Challenges, and Open Directions
research_problem: Bridging the compute divide between massive hyperscale cloud models and resource-limited edge nodes.
approach: Hierarchical collaboration scheme separating continuous model adaptation at edge from parameter training at cloud.
key_contribution: Taxonomy of split inference, model slicing, and continuous edge learning.
edge_relevance: Foundational architecture paper for edge intelligence and cloud-edge synergy.

title: Structured Model Pruning for Heterogeneous Edge Federated Learning
venue: IEEE Transactions on Parallel and Distributed Systems
research_problem: Client compute heterogeneity in federated learning causes lagging nodes (stragglers) to bottleneck convergence.
approach: Channel-wise structured pruning customized to individual client hardware capacity during local epochs.
key_contribution: Theoretical proof of convergence under heterogeneous model architectures; 4.1x communication reduction.
edge_relevance: Core federated learning and TinyML intersection for PhD research.

title: Online Convex Optimization for Real-Time Edge Resource Allocation
research_problem: Dynamic arrival of offloading tasks under time-varying edge wireless channel conditions without prior distribution.
approach: Lyapunov online optimization framework with sub-linear regret bounds and guaranteed queue stability.
key_contribution: Proved O(1/V) competitive ratio between energy consumption and average task delay.
edge_relevance: Mathematical optimization backbone for computation offloading and resource scheduling.

title: Carbon-Aware Edge Computing: Joint Energy Harvesting and Computation Scheduling
venue: ACM Transactions on Modeling and Performance Evaluation of Computing Systems
research_problem: Solar- and wind-powered edge nodes suffer from severe temporal power intermittency.
approach: Two-timescale predictive scheduling using transformer-based renewable generation forecasting and Lyapunov drift-plus-penalty.
key_contribution: Maintained 99.9% service SLA while reducing grid power draw by 67%.
edge_relevance: Direct connection to green and sustainable edge computing research directions.

title: Cooperative Edge Caching in 5G Networks with User Mobility Awareness
research_problem: Redundant data fetch over cellular backhaul under high user mobility across micro base stations.
approach: Reinforcement learning for proactive cache eviction and inter-base-station cooperative pre-fetching.
key_contribution: Reduced backhaul traffic load by 41% and reduced retrieval latency by 58%.
edge_relevance: Pioneered network optimization and caching in 5G mobile edge computing.

title: FedAdapt: Adaptive Federated Learning over Edge Networks
research_problem: Extreme variance in edge link bandwidth causing dropped gradient updates in decentralized training.
approach: Adaptive layer-wise gradient compression and dynamic deadline scaling based on TCP window metrics.
key_contribution: Accelerated wall-clock convergence time by 3.2x on real-world testbed of 20 edge nodes.
edge_relevance: Premier paper addressing communication-efficient distributed edge ML.

title: Cold-Start Mitigation for Edge FaaS using Predictive Micro-Sandboxing
research_problem: Container startup delays (100ms - 2s) severely degrade sporadic event-driven edge functions.
approach: WebAssembly micro-runtimes with LSTM invocation prediction for pre-warming execution contexts.
key_contribution: Cut 99th percentile tail latency by 78% with only 12MB memory overhead per worker node.
edge_relevance: Direct solution to edge serverless cold-start bottlenecks.

title: Dynamic Scheduling of Distributed Deep Learning Jobs in Edge-Cloud Clusters
research_problem: Contention for heterogeneous edge GPU resources among concurrent model training workloads.
approach: Fair-share packing heuristics combined with parameter server placement optimization.
key_contribution: Guaranteed dominant resource fairness while cutting training turnaround times by 40%.
edge_relevance: Essential reference for distributed systems scheduling in AIoT clusters.

title: Pipelined Collaborative Inference Across Heterogeneous Edge Devices
venue: ACM SIGCOMM 2024 Workshop on Edge Systems
research_problem: Memory saturation when running large language models on edge devices.
approach: Model tensor partitioning across local Wi-Fi mesh nodes with asynchronous pipeline execution.
key_contribution: Enabled 7B parameter LLM inference on consumer-grade edge hardware with sub-second response.
edge_relevance: Cutting-edge edge intelligence and split computing methodology.

title: Proactive Computation Offloading for Connected Autonomous Vehicles in 5G V2X Networks
venue: IEEE Transactions on Intelligent Transportation Systems
research_problem: High-velocity vehicles experience sudden handover disconnections from roadside edge units (RSUs).
approach: Spatial-temporal trajectory forecasting to pre-migrate execution states before vehicle arrives in next cell.
key_contribution: Zero task deadline violations during handovers up to 120 km/h vehicle speeds.
edge_relevance: Direct match for V2X edge computing and vehicular mobility management.

title: Fault-Tolerant Consensus Protocols for Edge Computing with Intermittent Links
research_problem: Traditional Raft and Paxos assume reliable LAN interconnects, failing when edge links experience frequent drops.
approach: Quorum adaptation and epoch-based state log synchronization tolerant to asymmetric network partitions.
key_contribution: Maintained safety invariants and achieved 3x higher commit throughput under 10% packet drop rates.
edge_relevance: Critical bridge between distributed systems theory and edge computing realities.

title: Benchmarking and Optimizing Deep Learning Inference on Mobile Edge GPUs
venue: IEEE Transactions on Parallel and Distributed Systems
research_problem: Lack of systematic profiling of memory bandwidth bottlenecks on edge GPUs (Nvidia Jetson, Apple Silicon).
approach: Fine-grained roofline model tailored to embedded Tensor Cores and low-precision INT4/INT8 operations.
key_contribution: Identified kernel fusion strategies boosting inference throughput by 2.4x on Jetson Orin.
edge_relevance: Benchmark dataset and methodology for edge AI systems.

title: Low-Complexity Video Compression and Analytics for Resource-Constrained Edge Sensors
venue: IEEE Transactions on Circuits and Systems for Video Technology
research_problem: Raw HD video streaming overwhelms IoT wireless links; edge encoding drains sensor batteries.
approach: Adaptive intra-frame rate-distortion optimization skipping redundant transform blocks.
key_contribution: Cut encoding complexity by 68% while retaining feature representations for edge object detection.
edge_relevance: IoT camera edge processing and resource-constrained sensing.

title: Statistical Learning and Anomaly Detection on Distributed Edge IoT Streams
research_problem: Real-time outlier detection on high-frequency IoT sensor telemetry without transmitting all raw points to cloud.
approach: Streaming kernel density estimation with distributed quantile aggregation.
key_contribution: Identified anomalies with 98.4% precision using only 5% of original transmission bandwidth.
edge_relevance: Edge telemetry, statistical edge computing, and smart educational campus IoT.
